citation: 1840 U.S. Census, population schedules, Chicago, Cook County, Illinois — FamilySearch digital images of the enumerator's sheets, division of S. W. Sherman.
locator: chicago/reference/census1840/ — 74 distinct JPEG page images in 75 files (33S7-9YYJ-*, 33SQ-GYYJ-*, 33S7-9YYN-*, 33SQ-GYYN-*); '33S7-9YYJ-9WF (1).jpg' is a byte-identical second copy of '33S7-9YYJ-9WF.jpg' and is not a distinct page
repository: FamilySearch, collection 1786457 (login-walled); the images are held in this repository's read-only reference deposit
what_it_supplies: the names of heads of families as written, in enumeration order
each household's line position on its printed page
the 13 free-white male and 13 free-white female age-band tallies
free coloured male and female counts
on the continuation sheets: the family total, the six industry columns, pensioners for revolutionary or military service, deaf/dumb/blind, and the schools and illiteracy columns
what_it_does_not_supply: any member of a household other than its head, by name
any statement about 1835 — it is later evidence and cannot on its own place a person in the scene
note: The senior reading for this census. Where the recovered v4 workbook transcription (census_1840_chicago_v4_research) and these sheets disagree, the sheet is taken as senior and both readings are kept — see data/research/census_1840/crosswalk_670.json.
